reviews.title: Misses the mark
reviews.text: Used this for a couple times until I realized the fatal flaw. Whatever time you select should be A WHOLE CIRCLE. If you set the timer for an hour, the circle should represent an hour. But if you set the timer for a half an hour., The circle should represent a half hour. That way you can visually see if half your time has elapsed.. This is especially important for kids who don’t necessarily think in terms of the hours.. They think I have this much time to do it, and oh look there’s half the time left. At the very least, there should be an option to have it work this way.

reviews.title: Live activities and Apple Watch
reviews.text: Unlike that this timer already syncs between my watch and my phone, but it would be great if it also had a live activity so you don’t always have to have your phone unlocked with the app open to see the time remaining. Additionally, if there was a simple little complication on Apple Watch that showed the disk, that would be great too. For it to a good time keeping tool, I feel like it shouldn’t be so easy to forget about it like it is currently without these features.

reviews.title: Freezes - Broken for the past 6 months
reviews.text:
I loved it initially! Great for time blindness!

But after buying my 1-year subscription, it started crashing. Specifically, whenever I tried to open “Timer Lists”.

I’ve already contacted support, but I’m seeing other people here having the same issues, so figured I’d leave a review.
